specification.initial_state: Assumed: all registers in a fixed basis state, then a uniform or tree-root-based starting state set up by the unspecified algorithm.

steps.description: Assumed: prepare the initial state on the index and work registers, encoding the formula tree structure.
Apply an unspecified sequence of discrete oracle queries interleaved with formula-dependent unitaries. The total number of queries is Q_bal(N)=O(sqrt N) for balanced formulas.
For arbitrary formulas, use the same kind of procedure with total queries bounded by Q_arb(N).

specification.measurement: Assumed: after the final query step, measure the designated output (root) qubit in the computational basis; the outcome is taken as the formula value. The abstract does not specify the measurement.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Assumed: output the measured bit as the formula value; optionally repeat a constant number of times and take the majority to reduce error. The abstract states no error probability.
